name: ci-scripts-integration
//: The gate's and the release's scripts driven for real: ci-base.sh over real git histories, build-dist.sh naming the artifact it built beside earlier builds, and sync-release-pr.sh bumping a release branch pushed to a local origin. Its test target's inputs are those scripts and what sync-release-pr.sh reads and writes, so no other script's change selects it.

options.command: uv run --frozen --no-sync ruff format --quiet --config scripts/ci-tests/ruff.toml scripts/ci-tests
uv run --frozen --no-sync ruff format --quiet --check --config scripts/ci-tests/ruff.toml scripts/ci-tests
uv run --frozen --no-sync ruff check --quiet --config scripts/ci-tests/ruff.toml scripts/ci-tests
